text.tspan: Multi-cloud with compliance: build once, sign, keep data in-region, enforce at admission
this registry only, non-root, no privileged
this registry only, non-root, no privileged
this registry only, non-root, no privileged
Same Helm chart + Argo CD ApplicationSet everywhere; Terraform per cloud with the same module layout.
Secrets from each cloud's store (or Vault) via External Secrets; logs and metrics stay in-region; deploy by digest, not tag.
Multi-cloud, Kyverno, cosign, Harbor are NOT on your resume: present the design, transfer your AWS/EKS experience.
